interpretation: A flexible explanation-writing guide alongside default or custom tone: clear ordering, familiar words, active voice, consistent terms, defined technical terms and usually short sentences. Retain requested depth, uncertainty and technical meaning. This is not a measured compliance percentage.
implementation: chatmock/chatmock/council/unslop.py: shared full and compact directives, before the optional personal profile. The profile instruction explicitly preserves the explanation rule.

regressionTests.coverage: Provider transport and HTTP routing; full and compact writing blocks; absent, saved and removed profiles; structured editor and machine-output contracts.

observations: All replies were read. Simple answers generally began with the idea or cause. Both detailed explanations retained the requested terms and time-constant equation.
GPT gave the more concise answers. Its voice reply was 26 words; Gemini's was 77 words. Gemini added an unnecessary farad detail in the Word explanation.
Some sentences still exceed 25 words, which is a flexible target in this rule. This evaluation does not establish strict STE compliance or reliable adherence on every future turn.

Style checks do not establish factual accuracy. The Gemini garden answer overgeneralized capacitor discharge after disconnection; a discharge path is needed. No technical content was edited by the harness.
liveReview.method: Live local gateway requests with production prompt builders and no client-supplied style directive. This is not a full UI test. Raw replies and model routing are preserved in replies.json.

activation: Only the verified source-based ChatMock worker was restarted. Its supervisor replaced it, and /health returned ok. See activation.json for the process and tested source hash.
